ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based screening of all directors, shareholders, and UBOs against the VFSC consolidated AML list, United Nations Security Council Consolidated List (1267/1988 and 2231), OFAC SDN List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and Australian DFAT sanctions list; mandatory enhanced due diligence for politically exposed persons, family members, and close associates under the AML/CFT Act No. 25 of 2023; adverse media and negative news checks; verification of source of funds with particular attention to subscription revenue derived through Apple IAP and Google Play Billing.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Company Registry — Online Name Reservation and Incorporation Portal (VFSC e-Services)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Names must be expressed in English, French, or Bislama using Latin script only; non-Latin scripts require approved transliteration. The registered name of an International Company must end with 'Limited', 'Ltd', 'Corporation', 'Corp', 'Incorporated', 'Inc', or a French equivalent such as 'SA' or 'SARL'. The name must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered name or a protected mark under the Trade Marks Act, and must not mislead as to the company's activities.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection the VFSC Registry issues a formal refusal notice citing the relevant ground under section 11 of the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]. The applicant may, within 14 days of the refusal, file written representations requesting reconsideration of the decision with supporting legal submissions. If the reconsideration is denied, the applicant may appeal to the VFSC Board of Commissioners within 30 days of the reconsideration decision. Final relief may be sought by way of judicial review before the Supreme Court of Vanuatu. Alternatively, a fresh name application may be submitted without prejudice. A name reservation may be extended before expiry by written application to the Registrar accompanied by the extension fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible only in the form of a registered office address maintained by a VFSC-licensed registered agent in Vanuatu; no physical operational office is required for this pure digital content platform. Statutory records, register of members, and UBO register must remain available for inspection at the registered office; a purely administrative virtual office with no local agent is not permitted.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low — estimated 5–10% annual probability of an unannounced on-site inspection for a low-risk, statutorily unlicensed ISIC 9000 digital publishing entity. VFSC and the AML/CFT supervisor retain the right to conduct off-site document inspections and unannounced physical visits; risk rises materially upon sanctions matches, PEP flags, adverse media, or regulatory complaints.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap 222], Republic of Vanuatu, as amended; in particular Sections 4 (incorporation), 5 (application for incorporation), 6 (duties of Registrar), 7 (registered office and registered agent), 8 (registered agent requirement), 9-15 (corporate governance and records); read with the Companies Act [Cap 191] for transitional and general company law matters where expressly applied.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - Companies & International Companies Registry, Port Vila, Republic of Vanuatu
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form ICA-1: 'Application for Incorporation of an International Company', together with executed Memorandum and Articles of Association and written Consents to Act of the Registered Agent and the First Director
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for a Vanuatu International Company; share capital may be denominated in any currency, partly or fully nil-paid, and no escrow account or capital duty is required at incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION (pro forma). RESOLVED that the subscribers named in the Memorandum are confirmed as subscribing for the initial issued share capital, and the allotment and issue of shares recorded in the Register of Members is approved and ratified. RESOLVED FURTHER that the registered office is established at the registered agent's address in Port Vila, Vanuatu, and the registered agent is authorized to accept service of process. RESOLVED FURTHER that [Director] is appointed sole Director and [Secretary] is appointed Secretary, each holding office until resignation, with full authority to open bank accounts, execute app Store agreements and banking mandates.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies & International Companies Registry (name search performed online via a licensed registered agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit one primary and two alternate company names to the licensed registered agent; the agent queries the VFSC name index and confirms that the proposed name does not conflict with a registrable entity or a protected trademark. The chosen name must end with a recognized suffix such as 'Limited'. Secure the cleared name and obtain a written name clearance receipt for the client file.
required_dossiers: Proposed company name (primary and two alternates)
Identity details of the applicant or instructing registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused or flagged as conflicting, the file is re-specified with the alternate names; upon confirmed conflict, a fresh reservation application is filed with a distinctive distinguishing element (e.g., 'Webnova VU Limited').

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Constitutional and Consent Instruments
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Vanuatu Registered Agent / Local Attorney
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association (with flexible single-member provisions), the ICA-1 incorporation application, registered agent consent, first-director consent, and subscriber statement. Execute the instruments before a notary; if executed outside Vanuatu, arrange notarization and apostille or consular legalization as directed by the registered agent.
required_dossiers: Form ICA-1 signed by an authorized subscriber
Certified copy of passport or directorship identity proof
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC queries signature, dating, or notarization defects, the registered agent re-submits corrected signature pages within five working days; if the apostille is rejected, a Vanuatu-notarized counterpart is executed to cure the deficiency.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Incorporation Application and Payment of Government Fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies & International Companies Registry (electronic filing through the registered agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File Form ICA-1 with the executed Memorandum and Articles of Association via the registered agent's VFSC submission channel; pay the official state filing fee of USD 300 (or VT equivalent) through the VFSC-approved payment gateway; retain the payment receipt as proof of duty for the client and the annual compliance record.
required_dossiers: Signed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Covering letter from the registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry issues a compliance query or rejection, the registered agent cures the stated omission (amendment of objects, corrective signatures, fee top-up) and re-files within seven working days; any applicable late fee is settled before re-submission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Trading Standing
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon satisfactory review, the Registrar registers the company and issues the Certificate of Incorporation dated on the filing day, together with the initial extract of the Register of Members; upon request, also obtain a Certificate of Good Standing to facilitate bank account opening and app-store merchant verification.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate contains a typographical error in the company name or incorporation date, file a formal rectification request with the Registry; the corrected certificate is issued after payment of any minor administrative fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registered Office Adoption, Officer Appointment and Governance Record Opening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Registered Agent and the First Board of Directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the first board meeting by written resolution adopting the registered office address at the registered agent's Port Vila office, appointing the director and secretary, approving the share issuance, and opening the statutory registers (members, directors, charges) and corporate minute book; issue share certificates and deposit the sealed records with the registered agent.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If statutory records are incomplete, the registered agent rectifies the registers and files a corrective board resolution; missing annual registered-agent fees may accrue but do not invalidate the already issued incorporation certificate.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - Business Licence Registry. Digital web fiction publishing (ISIC 9000) is not a licensed activity in Vanuatu; no Telecommunications, Radiocommunications and Broadcasting Regulator (TRBR) concession is required for a non-carrier online content platform acting solely as a publisher and subscription app.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable - pure offshore digital publishing; no Vanuatu Business Licence is required where no goods are sold and no services are supplied within Vanuatu. If a local back-office is opened, a standard 'General Services - Online Platform' Business Licence would be issued by the VFSC Business Licence Registry.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vanuatu Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - this is an intangible digital serial platform with no physical fixed installation, no land disturbance, no effluent or air emissions, and no solid waste generation; no EIA registration or full EIA report is required.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No wastewater, VOC, or particulate thresholds apply. The only peripheral environmental obligations concern minimal e-waste handling and recycling of office IT equipment under the Waste Management and Pollution Control Act [Cap 283], together with DEPC guidance on disposal of batteries and out-of-service devices.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not issued for a remote cloud-based operation. If a token back-office or customer-support office is established in Port Vila, a fire safety certificate must be obtained from the Vanuatu Fire and Emergency Services following inspection of alarms, extinguishers, and exit routes, and an occupational workplace clearance must be secured for workstations, ventilation, and first-aid provisions as required by national OHS rules.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Customs & Inland Revenue Department (CIRD), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management, Port Vila; official portal: https://customsinlandrevenue.gov.vu; company formation administered by Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), https://www.vfsc.vu/
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: An International Company (IC) is statutorily exempt from Vanuatu income/corporate/withholding taxes and exchange control under the International Companies Act 1993 (Cap 222), so no national income tax ID is issued to the entity; the VFSC Certificate of Incorporation constitutes its tax-exempt registration identity. Should the IC import goods into Vanuatu or make local taxable supplies through a Vanuatu branch, it must apply to CIRD for VAT registration on Form VR-01, submitting the Certificate of Incorporation, registered office lease evidence, memorandum/articles, director and shareholder particulars, and bank account confirmation; CIRD issues a VAT registration number within 7-10 business days. For the described offshore-only webnovel subscription model with revenue settled through Apple IAP and Google Play Billing, no VAT/TIN registration is triggered unless Vanuatu importation (e.g., office equipment, software hardware) occurs, in which case customs entry handling may require a temporary importer ID.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone; ICs are exempt for 20 years from registration from all Vanuatu taxes, duties, and exchange-control requirements (International Companies Act 1993, Cap 222, s.54), including no corporate income tax, no capital gains tax, no withholding tax, and no stamp duty on IC instruments; the entity is not a tax resident for income tax purposes since Vanuatu has no general income tax regime; the IC is permitted only offshore business activity and cannot carry on business with Vanuatu residents without VFSC consent.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box, CFC, hybrid-mismatch, or entity classification election exists in Vanuatu because the system levies no income tax; an IC may voluntarily elect to register for VAT under the Value Added Tax Act No. 10 of 2013 if engaging in local taxable supplies (this election is irrevocable for 24 months), may elect to redomicile into a foreign jurisdiction, or may convert to a local ordinary company under the Companies Act 2009 (Cap 191); the tax-exempt status is automatic and mandatory for ICs, not elective; foreign status of beneficial owners is evidenced at incorporation and does not require annual tax elections.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Value Added Tax) under the Value Added Tax Act No. 10 of 2013, administered by Vanuatu Customs & Inland Revenue Department; applies to taxable supplies of goods and services made in Vanuatu and to imports of goods; digital subscription service exports are outside the territorial scope.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VAT registration is mandatory for any person carrying on a taxable activity with annual taxable turnover of VT 5,000,000 or more (approx. USD 41,700); registration is also mandated for importers on the first import unless exempt; offshore digital sales by an IC to non-resident consumers do not count toward the Vanuatu turnover threshold because the supply is deemed made outside Vanuatu; voluntary registration is permitted for businesses below the threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, e-invoicing API, digital stamping, or continuous transaction control regime is in force in Vanuatu; CIRD accepts standard paper or PDF tax invoices and does not require pre-approval of invoice numbering; registered suppliers must issue compliant tax invoices showing supplier VAT ID, invoice date, description, VAT-exclusive amount, VAT amount, and total; for zero-rated exports, the invoice must carry a statement of zero-rating with the export justification; Apple IAP and Google Play Billing commission statements are treated as standard settlement documentation, not subject to any Vanuatu electronic fiscal clearance.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating at 0% VAT applies to (i) goods exported from Vanuatu with proof of physical departure, and (ii) services supplied to a non-resident person who is outside Vanuatu at the time of supply where the services are not connected with land or goods situated in Vanuatu (VAT Act No. 10 of 2013, Schedule 1). Subscription access to the serialized webnovel platform via Apple IAP and Google Play Billing qualifies as an offshore digital service provided the platform maintains contemporaneous evidence that each consumer's billing address, IP geolocation, app-store territory, and payment instrument are outside Vanuatu; app-store settlement reports showing the Apple/Google deduction of commissions and remittance to the IC are the primary evidence; no physical customs export declaration is required for intangible digital delivery.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (CusDec) required only for physical goods supporting the platform (e.g., books, merchandise, or equipment)
Bill of Lading/Airway Bill evidencing physical export (for goods); for digital services, the app-store settlement report and server/geolocation logs substitute for carriage documents
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank SWIFT/MT103 confirmation evidencing receipt of subscription proceeds from Apple/Google treasury centers or foreign banks
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: CIRD may audit VAT and zero-rating claims for up to 5 fiscal years; fraudulent zero-rating declaration or deliberate mischaracterization of domestic supplies as exports attracts a penalty of up to 200% of the tax sought to be evaded plus interest at 18% per annum, and where the fraud involves forged customs or banking documents, criminal prosecution with fines up to VT 10,000,000 and imprisonment up to 7 years is possible; retrospective output VAT reassessment and disallowance of all associated input tax credits are applied for the entire audit period where the exporter cannot substantiate non-resident recipient status or overseas delivery; for digital platforms, failure to maintain app-store territory reports and payment-rail settlement records for 5 years creates a rebuttable presumption of domestic taxable supply.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), operating under the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Act 1981 and the Financial Dealers Licensing Act; exchange control policy is administered by RBV for authorised banks and the Ministry of Finance retains statutory oversight functions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu maintains a liberal foreign-exchange regime; the Vatu is convertible for both current-account and capital-account transactions. There are no quantitative exchange-control limits on non-resident International Company accounts, and no general requirement for central bank licensing of inward equity injections. Profit and dividend remittance is permitted after the presenting bank completes source-of-funds, AML/KYC, and corporate-validity verification. Because the International Company is not a Vanuatu tax resident under the International Companies Act, no Vanuatu withholding taxes apply to such outbound remittances; the only practical hurdles are bank-level documentary requirements and the need to demonstrate that no local Vanuatu business is being conducted.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. Vanuatu does not impose any statutory export-proceeds surrender requirement or mandatory conversion ratio. Digital platform subscription receipts, app-store proceeds, publishing royalties, and other cross-border service receipts may be retained in foreign currency in an authorised dealer account or converted to Vatu at the prevailing market rate, subject only to the presenting bank's AML and reporting obligations.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational USD/VUV Account; optional Capital Escrow Account for initial shareholder injection
Operational USD Account and Capital Escrow Account
Operational Settlement Account in USD or VUV
Domestic VUV Operational Account; less suited for pure offshore International Company treasury

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low to Medium as a principal clearing rail. Vanuatu does not recognise any foreign EMI passporting regime. A non-resident digital EMI may be used as a supplementary payment aggregator to consolidate Apple IAP and Google Play Billing receivables, but any entity accepting deposits or conducting money transmission within Vanuatu must be licensed by the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu. The International Company should maintain its ultimate liquidity and disbursement account at an RBV-licensed commercial bank and must not rely on an offshore EMI as the primary treasury account.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: At least one director and at least one ultimate beneficial owner are generally required to complete an in-person or officially notarised identity verification before an authorised bank certifier. Pure remote account opening is not a right in Vanuatu; however, RBV-licensed banks may supplement the process with a video interview, a local corporate-service-provider introduction, and original apostilled corporate documents. The majority of Vanuatu banks will require physical attendance by the signatory director before the account is activated.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: International Company with offshore incorporation, no local business presence, and tax-exempt status.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of incorporation, certificate of incumbency, registered agent confirmation, beneficial ownership declaration, notarised board resolution opening the account, audited or internally prepared financial statements, local registered-office address, and an explanation of the substantive WebNovel subscription business outside Vanuatu.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Receipts originating from Apple IAP and Google Play Billing rather than direct customer wires, creating mismatches between app-store payout files and the bank statement.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Duly executed Apple Developer Program agreement, Google Play Developer distribution agreement, app-store payout reports and reconciliation statements, end-user subscription terms, merchant tax registrations, and a monthly cash-flow model linking app-store proceeds to the Vanuatu treasury account.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Outbound disbursements to authors, content licensors, or related affiliates in various jurisdictions without clear contractual substance.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed publishing and licensing agreements, royalty calculation schedules, author identification and beneficial ownership evidence, tax-residence and withholding-tax certificates, VAT/goods-and-services status where relevant, and intercompany transfer-pricing documentation consistent with ISIC 9000 digital-content activity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Vanuatu's presence on international AML / FATF monitoring lists or use of third-country shareholders exposed to sanctions risk.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Enhanced due diligence file, sanction-screen results and timeline, source-of-wealth declaration for each shareholder, independent legal opinion confirming beneficial ownership chain, adoption of a credible transaction-monitoring policy, and appointment of a locally registered AML compliance officer.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound shareholder capital injections should be routed by SWIFT MT103 or MT101 from the shareholder's bank directly to the Vanuatu account at an RBV-licensed bank. The MT103 beneficiary account description must identify the International Company and the corporate account name; the narrative field should state 'Shareholder Capital Injection under Board Resolution [Reference] for WebNovel Subscription Platform'. The presenting Vanuatu bank will require a funds-source questionnaire, a copy of the board resolution, a shareholders' register extract, and proof of identity of the remitting shareholder. There is no RBV pre-approval requirement for foreign-owned International Company equity injections, but the bank will classify and report the entry as a capital-account transaction in its regulatory returns.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Settlement rails for trade disbursements must be US-dollar priority or standard SWIFT MT103 transfers from the Vanuatu corporate account. For high-value content acquisition or adaptation-rights licences, an irrevocable documentary letter of credit issued under UCP600 by an RBV-licensed bank may be used, although the digital WebNovel subscription model does not generally require LC-based trade settlement. Recurring payments to authors, aggregate royalty reporting, and app-store reconciliation cycles should use straight-through-processing SWIFT MT103 wires with precise remittance codes. Apple IAP and Google Play Billing settlements are received initially by the foreign merchant-account bank and then swept into the Vanuatu International Company account; no local VUV clearing is required for the offshore platform operations.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable USD/VUV forward contracts with an RBV-licensed authorised dealer, based on documented forecast subscription receipts and disbursement commitments.
Offshore non-deliverable USD/VUV forwards referencing VUV where onshore deliverable liquidity is insufficient, used strictly to hedge translation or economic exposure of the WebNovel platform.
Cross-currency swaps between USD and AUD/EUR for matched author-royalty and content-licence disbursement streams, executed through the International Company's investment-grade banking counterparty.

Vanuatu currently has no active exchange-traded derivatives market; FX options and exotic hedges require bespoke OTC approval and are treated as treasury-risk instruments rather than routine permissible hedging products.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after each anniversary of the company's incorporation date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of USD 50 plus USD 20 per month of delay; continued non-filing for more than 12 months may trigger administrative strike-off and dissolution.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual registration renewal and payment of annual license/exemption fee
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) through the licensed registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the incorporation anniversary, in conjunction with the annual return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment accrues monthly penalties and may lead to suspension of the exempt status; continued failure can result in removal from the register after a 12-month delinquency period.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit is required for a standard Vanuatu International Company. An independent audit is only mandatory if the company is licensed for a special activity (e.g., banking, insurance, or managed trust business) or if its articles of association voluntarily require an audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No statutory financial statements are required to be filed. If accounts are prepared internally, application of IFRS or generally recognized local accounting principles is acceptable for management, investor reporting, and creditor purposes.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Vanuatu does not maintain a public UBO register for International Companies. The registered agent is required to hold current client due diligence records and to update the private UBO information upon any share transfer. Annually, the registered agent issues a certificate confirming acting directors, members, and ultimate beneficial ownership as reflected in the company's statutory registers.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 650 – USD 1,500 per annum for licensed registered agent and registered office services
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not applicable for an exempt International Company; voluntarily commissioned certified audit typically ranges from USD 1,500 to USD 5,000

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% (nil). Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax on any taxpayer class. An International Company (IC) incorporated under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222] is additionally granted an express statutory income tax exemption by Section 34 of that Act, which provides that no tax is payable to the Government of Vanuatu in respect of the IC's income or profits.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Zero effective income tax rate for all operating and passive income derived through the IC. Ancillary levies relevant to a webnovel subscription platform: (i) Value Added Tax at 12.5% under the VAT Act [Cap. 195] on taxable digital subscription supplies to Vanuatu-resident consumers once annual taxable turnover exceeds the registration threshold; (ii) Payroll Tax at 1% (Vanuatu-resident employees) and 3% (expatriates) under the Payroll Tax Act [Cap. 252] only where the IC employs staff physically present in Vanuatu; (iii) annual VFSC government renewal fees. No capital gains, estate, inheritance, or transfer taxes are levied on ICs.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VFSC International Company Annual Return (Form IC-AR) – lodged by the Vanuatu-registered licensed registered agent through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) compliance portal. There is no direct online filer interface for the shareholder; the registered agent remains the statutory filing intermediary.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The annual return must be delivered to the registered agent on or before the anniversary date of incorporation in each year; the registered agent is thereafter obligated to submit the return to VFSC with the applicable annual government fee. No legislative grace period exists; late submissions attract late lodgement charges.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name of the International Company and VFSC registration number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the exact IC name; non-resident status does not alter the filing obligation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 2 – Registered office and registered agent
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Vanuatu physical registered office address and licensed registered agent details.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must reflect the mandatory Vanuatu-registered agent; a non-resident director cannot replace this requirement.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 3 – Share capital and shareholding summary
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Issued shares, paid-up currency, and class of shares.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide the non-resident shareholders' names and voting percentages; bearer shares are prohibited.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names, nationalities, and service addresses of all directors.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors are permitted; a real service address is required for AML/KYC verification.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Identifies every natural person ultimately owning or controlling the IC, per the Beneficial Ownership Act.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must include passport/ID copies and code verification; the registered agent must refresh BO data on each annual return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Certifies that the IC claims the Section 34 IC Act tax exemption and confirms no taxable activity regulated by Vanuatu national tax law is conducted in-country.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The IC may simultaneously apply to VFSC for a Certificate of Taxation Status for foreign counterparties.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing incurs a monetary penalty per month of delay (up to Vt 50,000 in accumulated late charges in standard VFSC practice) and risks administrative suspension. Persistent failure to file for consecutive anniversaries results in strike-off/deregistration of the IC, automatic termination of the Section 34 exemption, and payment of restoration fees prior to reinstatement.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Vanuatu VAT Return (Form VAT-100) – submitted electronically through the Vanuatu Department of Customs and Inland Revenue (DCIR) online filing portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Monthly, with a statutory VAT tax period of one calendar month; nil monthly returns must still be submitted. Where annual taxable turnover is below the registration threshold and registration was voluntary, DCIR may direct quarterly filing.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The VAT return and net tax payment are due on or before the 30th day of the month immediately following the end of the tax period.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross consideration from digital webnovel subscription sales, in-app purchases, and premium reading features where the supply is enjoyed by a customer in Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The IC, a Vanuatu-resident entity, is the supplier of record. Include amounts received via Apple IAP and Google Play Billing gross of the platform commission, with VAT output tax accounted on the consumer-facing price in vatu.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Subscription revenue attributable to non-resident customers located outside Vanuatu is an export of services and is zero-rated.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Maintain validated evidence of non-resident status (geolocation, verified billing address, operator partition reports); inadequate evidence results in DCIR recharacterization as local taxable supplies.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Recoverable VAT on qualifying local acquisitions (e.g., Vanuatu-registered advertising, local marketing, office services).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apple/Google commission invoices are foreign supplies outside Vanuatu VAT; no input credit exists for those levies. Input VAT requires a valid VAT invoice from a Vanuatu-registered person.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Output VAT less input VAT; if negative, the refund claim section is activated.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For non-resident shareholders, refunds may be applied against future liabilities or paid out only after DCIR compliance inspection; withhold any refund request until all revenue reconciliations are auditable.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late payment attracts a default surcharge of 5% of the unpaid VAT for each month or part thereof, capped at 25%; late filing is subject to fixed penalties. Knowingly submitting false VAT statements constitutes an offence under the VAT Act, punishable by a fine of up to Vt 1,000,000 and/or imprisonment for up to 2 years, together with reassessment of net VAT due.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Employer Payroll Tax Monthly Return (Form PTR-1) – filed electronically via the DCIR portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due on or before the 30th day of the month following the month of remuneration payment.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total gross remuneration subject to payroll tax at 1%.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Relevant only if the IC has employees working in Vanuatu; remote foreign employees fall outside the Vanuatu payroll tax base.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line B – Expatriate / non-resident employees working in Vanuatu
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross remuneration for non-citizen work permit holders taxed at 3%.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The IC must deduct and remit payroll tax as an employer; the tax applies irrespective of the source of funds used to pay salary.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: 1% of Line A plus 3% of Line B.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No declaration of payroll tax is required if the IC has zero Vanuatu-employed personnel, but the employer registration status must be closed formally with DCIR.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Unpaid payroll tax attracts default interest and a monthly surcharge in line with tax arrears collection rules; employer non-deduction is recoverable from the directors personally, and late submissions incur fixed fines with possible prosecution for repeated non-compliance.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0%. Vanuatu levies no dividend withholding tax at either statutory or practical level. An International Company is free to declare and pay dividends to its non-resident shareholders from the webnovel platform's retained earnings without any Vanuatu tax deduction, clearance, or exchange-control approval.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has not entered into a comprehensive double tax agreement (DTA) network; therefore no treaty-relief administrative mechanism exists under Vanuatu domestic law. For foreign jurisdictions that impose dividend/royalty withholding on Vanuatu payees, the operative protocol is: (1) apply to VFSC for a Certificate of Taxation Status / Tax Exemption Certificate issued under Section 34 of the International Companies Act; (2) deliver this certificate to the foreign payer or foreign revenue authority together with the IC's self-declaration of beneficial ownership; (3) where the IC deals with U.S. counterparties, complete and submit Form W-8BEN-E claiming the applicable treaty or statutory rate with the IC's Vanuatu address; (4) retain contemporaneous board resolutions proving the dividend was declared from genuinely earned subscription revenue and not from artificial intercompany financing. Vanuatu itself issues no tax residence certificate because it imposes no income tax; the s.34 taxation-status certificate is the internationally recognized substitute.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory Vanuatu withholding rate on royalties is 0%, and the statutory rate on interest is 0%. Vanuatu law contains no collection machinery for WHT on payments made by an IC to a foreign licensor of webnovel literary content, software, or app-distribution rights, nor on interest paid to intra-group lenders. Owing to the absence of a DTA network, foreign-source withholding levied by the country of the payer (e.g., U.S. FDAP 30% statutory withholding on royalties paid by a U.S. distributor to the IC) cannot be reduced by a Vanuatu treaty; mitigation requires the foreign jurisdiction's domestic exemptions or the substance evidence provided by the VFSC certificate.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable (no statutory threshold exists). Vanuatu has no corporate income tax and no transfer-pricing legislation; the International Company exemption means no Local File, Master File, or country-by-country reporting threshold can arise under Vanuatu domestic law. In practice, foreign tax authorities of the shareholder's residence jurisdiction may impute arm's-length remuneration to the IC in respect of webnovel licensing, in-app purchase commissions, and API/data services intercompany flows; the foreign threshold (typically EUR 750M consolidated group revenue for TP documentation under OECD standards) will then govern the preparation of documentation.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP (Comparable Uncontrolled Price) – applicable to app-store distribution commissions and third-party content licensing benchmarks
Resale Price Method – applicable to platform subscription resale structures where the IC markets foreign-owned digital content
Cost Plus Method – applicable to software development and localization services rendered to related parties
TNMM (Transactional Net Margin Method) – preferred for subscription-platform operating margins where reliable comparables exist
Profit Split Method – applicable to complex integrated digital content development where both the IC and the foreign affiliate contribute unique intangibles
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu has not enacted Economic Substance Regulations in the form adopted by the Cayman Islands or BVI. Nevertheless, the functional equivalent is enforced through the VFSC's beneficial ownership regime and the OECD's Harmful Tax Practices peer review. A VU_IC operating the webnovel serial platform must demonstrate real economic nexus where challenged by foreign tax authorities: (i) board meetings and strategic decision-making recorded in Vanuatu minutes; (ii) maintenance of books and records within the registered agent's custody or accessible from Vanuatu; (iii) a genuine Vanuatu-registered agent and office address not used solely as a mail-drop; and (iv) contractual substance for IT hosting, payment gateway, and content-licensing arrangements. Absent such substance, the IC may be reclassified as a shell conduit, and foreign CFC or controlled-foreign-corporation rules may attribute the subscription income to the ultimate non-resident shareholder.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Knowingly omitting Apple IAP and Google Play Billing subscription revenue from monthly VAT returns, fabricating export evidence to zero-rate domestic Vanuatu-consumer sales, or operating split-settlement arrangements that conceal the full consideration for digital fiction services.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the VAT Act default surcharge rules: 5% monthly surcharge on unpaid tax, capped at 25%, plus interest. Criminal prosecution for false VAT statements carries a fine of up to Vt 1,000,000 and/or imprisonment of up to 2 years. VFSC may simultaneously deregister the IC, extinguishing the s.34 tax exemption and requiring restoration proceedings.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false VAT returns are subject to personal criminal prosecution; courts may impose restitution orders for unpaid VAT, 10-year director disqualification, travel bans pending criminal proceedings, and imprisonment in cases of aggravated fraud where the amount concealed exceeds Vt 5,000,000.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company Abuse / Non-Filing of VFSC Annual Return
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to file the IC annual return and pay renewal fees for consecutive years, knowingly filing a false beneficial ownership declaration, operating the webnovel platform for the sole purpose of avoiding foreign taxation while maintaining no Vanuatu bank account, no webnovel content ownership, and no decision-making infrastructure.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Late-lodgement monetary penalties (accumulating beyond Vt 50,000), administrative suspension, and strike-off from the International Companies Register. A struck-off IC loses all statutory powers, its assets vest in the custody of the VFSC, and its contracts become unenforceable until restoration with full penalty payment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who continue to trade under a struck-off name incur personal liability for all debts contracted after deregistration; criminal penalties include fines and up to 12 months' imprisonment, and the court may freeze the director's foreign bank accounts through mutual legal assistance requests initiated by the Vanuatu Public Prosecutor.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Concealing the true natural person who receives webnovel subscription profits behind nominee shareholders, failing to update the VFSC beneficial ownership register within statutory timelines, or processing reader payments originating from sanctioned jurisdictions without enhanced due diligence.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Enforcement under the Beneficial Ownership Act includes administrative fines scaled to the number of violations and penalty notices issued by the VFSC. In money-laundering cases, the Financial Intelligence Unit may order freezing of the merchant settlement accounts; the registered agent is obliged to file a suspicious transaction report and may terminate its agency, forcing the IC into non-compliance and automatic strike-off.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and ultimate beneficial owners face criminal liability with fines and imprisonment for MLAT-assisted offences; the corporate veil is pierced to permit confiscation of the unlawfully concealed platform revenues, and a travel ban / stop-order can be issued pending asset-return undertakings.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Substance Deficiency / Foreign Recharacterization as a Deviator from Arm's-Length Conduct
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Structuring the entire webnovel enterprise so that the IC merely holds subscriptions while the management, content development, editorial control, and risk-bearing decisions are exercised entirely offshore by the parent; or pricing intercompany content-license fees at zero/manufactured levels so that foreign tax authorities impute taxable profit to the IC's offshore parent.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vanuatu imposes no direct financial sanction on the IC for foreign recharacterization. The operative sanction is extra-statutory and external: the foreign revenue authority reassesses the ultimate shareholder's tax base, applies transfer-pricing adjustments and penalty rates of up to 200% of the underpaid foreign tax, and denies any credit for the IC's zero Vanuatu tax. Fatal contractual consequence: the foreign group may be blacklisted from regulated app-store payout programs for a sham corporate structure.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Under foreign anti-abuse doctrines, the IC's income is attributed directly to the controlling directors as undisclosed beneficiaries; personal deficiency penalties, U.S. FBAR-style civil fraud penalties, criminal tax referrals, and international travel restrictions may be imposed; in the EU branch of the activity, disqualification orders prohibit the directors from acting as managers of any digital-commerce entity for up to 5 years.
